name: web-sandbox
description: Monorepo sandbox for trying web tools with auth, React, Express, and SQLite

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @web-sandbox/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @web-sandbox/api" "npm run dev -w @web-sandbox/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @web-sandbox/shared && npm run build -w @web-sandbox/api && npm run build -w @web-sandbox/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @web-sandbox/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @web-sandbox/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
